title: A word from the President of GUDECA Europe
excerpt: In his end-of-year address, GUDECA Europe President Constantine Ndenge described 2025 as a year of unity, and set out what the branch delivered for the village — solar street lights, the FUN electricity project and the Mbengeghang water project.
sourceNote: End-of-year address by Constantine Ndenge, President of GUDECA Europe, 31 December 2025.
body:
In his end-of-year address of 31 December 2025, Constantine Ndenge, President of GUDECA Europe, described 2025 as “a year of unity and family coming together.”

The branch held its annual gathering in Duisburg, Germany, bringing together members near and far.

Delivered in 2025

Through collective effort the branch contributed to:

  • Installation of solar street lights in the village
  • Contributions toward the FUN electricity project
  • Support for the Mbengeghang water project
  • Several other smaller but impactful community projects

A call to those lagging behind

The President called on members who had fallen behind to join the collective journey, to impact lives in the village, and to ensure sustainable growth, continuity and a legacy worthy of where our parents left off. He offered a personal apology and a call for unity going into 2026, and invited members to the gathering held that March in Germany.
